## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2012-03-05: Form-of TRA filed as Exhibit 10.33 to S-1/A Amendment No. 5.
- 2012-03-21: Vantiv Up-C IPO closes; TRA executed between Vantiv, Inc., Fifth Third Bank, FTPS Partners, LLC, the Advent Stockholders, Advent International Corporation, and JPDN Enterprises, LLC; 85% of Realized Tax Benefits on NPC Group, Inc.'s pre-IPO NOLs, capital losses, charitable deductions, AMT credit carryforwards, and Section 197 intangible amortization.
- 2012-05-08: Executed TRA filed as Exhibit 10.9 to Q1 2012 10-Q.

#### Partial terminations (Advent and JPDN exits)

- 2013-10-23: Advent Termination Agreement releases Advent's portion; JPDN Termination Agreement releases JPDN's portion. Fifth Third's share remains in force.

#### Fifth Third settlement structure

- 2015-10-23: Tax Receivable Purchase Addendum settles Fifth Third's portion of the NPC NOLs for 2016 and thereafter (jointly with the Fifth Third basis-step-up TRA).
- 2016-07-27: Second Tax Receivable Purchase Addendum extends call/put settlement to Pre-IPO NPC Intangibles for 2017 and thereafter.

#### FIS acquisition

- 2019-07-31: FIS acquires Worldpay; Fifth Third's residual NPC NOLs TRA interest survives the merger at the FIS-subsidiary level.

## Explanation

This TRA covers Vantiv subsidiary NPC Group, Inc.'s pre-IPO tax attributes: NOLs, capital losses, charitable deductions, AMT credit carryforwards, and Section 197 amortization of pre-IPO acquired intangibles. The three pre-IPO investor groups (Fifth Third, Advent, JPDN) share at percentages tied to their pre-IPO Vantiv Holding ownership, with Vantiv paying 85% of Realized Tax Benefits across all covered attributes. The contract partially terminated on October 23, 2013 when Advent and JPDN exited via the same termination instruments that settled their separate basis-step-up TRAs; Fifth Third's share remained in force and was subsequently settled in stages via the October 2015 and July 2016 Tax Receivable Purchase Addendums (cap-and-release and call/put structures jointly with the Fifth Third basis-step-up TRA). Worldpay's 2018 10-K aggregates Fifth Third's residual NPC NOLs interest with the Fifth Third basis-step-up TRA on the same "TRA with Fifth Third Bank" line. The Fifth Third residual interest survived Worldpay's July 31, 2019 acquisition by FIS; status is Unknown pending FIS post-close disclosure. See `contract_log.md` for the parallel-TRA mapping and the full filing-by-filing record.
